rationale: Collects findings from the four explicitly required sources: T1 (dataset description), T3 (provider/network patterns), T4 (denial analysis), and T7 (high-cost model). Brief sections address all mandate requirements: key findings, model performance, limitations, and next steps. Language set to avoid causal phrasing per T3 feedback. Report incorporates all substantive caveats from earlier feedback (synthetic data, sample preview, association/causation distinction, small group instability, model limitations, and operational-use restrictions) to ensure executive has full context. Denominators shown for statistical transparency.
